highlights: New (Optional-enabled by default) Weather-based dynamic theming with rain, snow, shimmer, and thunderstorm effects
New Scrap Sale mode with simplified UI and auto-calculated 2% GST TDS
New Proforma mode on sale page — replaces old order register window
New Kiosk Mode (skeleton) — local web server for mobile self-service sales
Server-pushed announcement banners and festive custom themes
In-app Help Viewer with search and guided feature tour
Hourly weather refresh — theme auto-updates on all windows
New Catalog Creator window for stock classification and Kiosk display
A new Welcome screen and feature-tour after update
New Update Presenter window for showing changelog and update instructions - available from next update
fullchange: Weather Theme System: Dynamic themes (summer, monsoon, winter, cloudy, haze, thunderstorm, festive, night) with animated effects on logo, scheduler, and notification panel. Dark mode and night-time variants included.
Weather Theme: Server-synced via /api/weather-theme endpoint using business city from Place of Jurisdiction.
Weather Theme: Added useWeatherTheme flag in appearance settings to enable/disable. Toggle button in sidebar to reset to default theme.
Announcement Banners: Server-pushed dismissible banners with CTA buttons, expiry dates, and display-once tracking. Appears as sticky bar on main page.
Custom Festive Theme: Server-downloadable CSS via /api/custom-theme. Layers festive decorations on top of existing theme. Supports Diwali, Durga Puja, Holi, Christmas etc.

Custom Theme: Added data-ui markers to all 10 main pages (mainPage, lockScreen, salePage, purchaseTemplate, customerPortal, supplierPortal, stockDisplay, showSale, purchaseDisplay, checkOutPayments) for CSS targeting.
Feature Tour: Global guided walkthrough of [isUpdated] elements with spotlight overlay, tooltip with arrow, and progress counter. Auto-runs on every renderer page.
Help Viewer: New 800x600 modal window with full markdown renderer, search with highlighting, section filtering by role (admin-only, unavailable). Bundled HELP.md + server-pushed /api/help-content.
Scrap Sale Mode: New billType 'scrap' with radio button on Page 2. Simplified Page 3 with Quantity + Rate inputs, auto-calculated 18% GST + 2% Scrap TDS tax summary.
Scrap Sale: PDF templates (both Template 1 and 2) show 'Scrap TDS (2%)' line below GST, included in Grand Total. Template 2 dynamically reduces font size to prevent overflow.
Scrap Sale: All item-table functions (merge, group, describe, label, delete) guarded with billType check to prevent errors in scrap mode.

S3 Encrypted Log Upload: New feature — encrypted .enc log files now upload to S3 cloud storage via pre-signed URLs. Includes Content-MD5 integrity verification, duplicate upload prevention, and automatic local cleanup after confirmed upload.

Fixed weather theme not applying to modal windows (customerPortal, salePage, etc.) — all windows share persist:bbs_auth partition. Fix: inject themes.css + reapply theme via createModal on did-finish-load.
Fixed weather theme form selector too broad — scoped to [data-ui='login-form'] to prevent gradient backgrounds on sale page form.
Created SERVER_API.md — complete VPS server implementation reference with all 6 endpoints, Express.js code, WeatherAPI mapping table, and festive CSS examples.
viewManager.js refactored: removed unused HTML-push code (getViewPath, checkServerForView, viewCache), merged themeManager functionality.
Updated HELP.md with 20-section user guide, machine-parseable meta block (HELP-META), role/status markers for admin-only and unavailable sections.
Proforma Mode: New billType 'proforma' radio on sale Page 2. Creates proforma invoice without reducing stock. Auto-generates proforma bill number. Viewed in existing order viewer.
Proforma Mode: Order viewer '+' button now opens sale page with useProforma flag to auto-enable proforma radio. Deprecated old orderRegister window.
Kiosk Mode: New local HTTP server (kioskServer.js) serving mobile-friendly sale interface with PIN auth, product grid, cart, and checkout. Accessible from any device on LAN.
Kiosk Mode: QR code modal on launch — scan to connect. Status toggle button in mainPage sidebar. Launchable from Sale menu.
Kiosk Mode: Server does NOT auto-start. PIN configurable via process.presets.kioskPIN.
Weather Theme: Added rain drop effect to thunderstorm theme alongside existing lightning flashes. Combined animation (rainFall + thunderFlash).
Weather Theme: Hourly setInterval re-fetches weather and re-applies theme to all open windows if changed. Interval cleared on weather disable and app quit.
Menu changes: Replaced 'New order' with 'Start Kiosk Mode' in Sale menu. Kept 'View Orders' for proforma order viewing.
New Catalog Creator window for stock classification and Kiosk display. Allows creating categories, subcategories, and product lists for Kiosk Mode. Accessible from mainPage main menu.

New Update Presenter window for showing changelog and update instructions - available from next update. Displays changelog.json content in a scrollable modal with search and copy-to-clipboard functionality.
